Name: Enemy at the Gate
Reward: Skill gem choice (class-dependent, e.g. Freezing Pulse / Cleave); town access.
Requirement: Kill Hillock; speak to Tarkleigh.

Name: Mercy Mission
Reward: Choose a Medium Life, Medium Mana or Quicksilver Flask; support gem choice (class-dependent).
Requirement: Return Hailrake's Medicine Chest to Nessa; speak to Bestel.

Name: A Dirty Job
Reward: 2 passive refund points (Book of Regrets).
Requirement: Clear every monster in the Fetid Pool; speak to Tarkleigh.

Name: Breaking Some Eggs
Reward: Skill gem choice (class-dependent); Submerged Passage access.
Requirement: Collect all three glyphs in the Mud Flats; open the glyph wall; speak to Tarkleigh.

Name: The Dweller of the Deep
Reward: 1 passive skill point.
Requirement: Kill the Dweller in the Flooded Depths; speak to Tarkleigh.

Name: The Way Forward
Reward: 1 passive skill point.
Requirement: Open the blocked pass from the Act 2 Western Forest; return to Bestel in Act 1.

Name: The Caged Brute
Reward: Skill and support gem choices (class-dependent); passage beyond Brutus.
Requirement: Kill Brutus; claim Tarkleigh's rewards.

Name: The Marooned Mariner
Reward: 1 passive skill point.
Requirement: Find the Allflame; defeat Fairgraves; speak to Bestel.

Name: The Siren's Cadence
Reward: Skill gem choice (class-dependent); access to Act 2.
Requirement: Defeat Merveil; claim Nessa's reward.

Name: The Lord's Labyrinth
Reward: Ascendancy class on first Labyrinth; 2 Ascendancy points per first completion of each difficulty; Divine Font use.
Requirement: Spans the campaign and endgame. Complete the trials, level requirements and each Labyrinth; rewards are not all from the first trial.

Name: Deal with the Bandits
Reward: Choose ONE: kill all for 1 passive point; help Alira for +15% all elemental resistances; Oak for +40 life; Kraityn for 8% movement speed. The Apex advances the story.
Requirement: Help one leader and kill the other two, OR kill all three. Subquests below are alternative branches, not three mandatory kills.

Name: The Bandit Lord Alira
Reward: Alira branch of Deal with the Bandits; not an additional reward.
Requirement: Choose help OR kill as part of the fixed bandit decision; see the parent quest for the mutually exclusive rewards.

Name: The Bandit Lord Oak
Reward: Oak branch of Deal with the Bandits; not an additional reward.
Requirement: Choose help OR kill as part of the fixed bandit decision; see the parent quest for the mutually exclusive rewards.

Name: The Bandit Lord Kraityn
Reward: Kraityn branch of Deal with the Bandits; not an additional reward.
Requirement: Choose help OR kill as part of the fixed bandit decision; see the parent quest for the mutually exclusive rewards.

Name: The Great White Beast
Reward: Choose a flask or belt (e.g. Quicksilver Flask / Heavy Belt).
Requirement: Kill the Great White Beast in the Den; speak to Yeena.

Name: Intruders in Black
Reward: Skill gem choice (class-dependent); Baleful Gem for story progression.
Requirement: Defeat Fidelitas in the Chamber of Sins; retrieve the Baleful Gem; speak to Greust.

Name: Sharp and Cruel
Reward: Support gem choice (class-dependent); Maligaro's Spike for story progression.
Requirement: Kill the Weaver; return Maligaro's Spike to Silk.

Name: Through Sacred Ground
Reward: 1 passive skill point and 2 passive refund points.
Requirement: Retrieve the Golden Hand from the Crypt; speak to Yeena.

Name: The Root of the Problem
Reward: Passage to the Vaal Ruins; no separate reward choice listed.
Requirement: Use Maligaro's Spike and the Baleful Gem on the blocking roots.

Name: Shadow of the Vaal
Reward: Access to Act 3; no separate reward choice listed.
Requirement: Use the Apex; defeat the Vaal Oversoul.

Name: Einhar's Hunt
Reward: Bestiary / Menagerie introduction; no fixed item reward listed.
Requirement: Capture beasts with Einhar; speak to him.

Name: Einhar's Menagerie
Reward: Beastcrafting tutorial; no fixed item reward listed.
Requirement: After Einhar's Hunt, perform a beastcraft in the Menagerie.

Name: Safe and Sound
Reward: Hideout and crafting-bench introduction.
Requirement: Claim a hideout with Helena and enhance an item.

Name: Lost in Love
Reward: Sewer Keys; skill gem choice (class-dependent).
Requirement: Rescue Clarissa; recover Tolman's Bracelet; speak to Clarissa.

Name: Sever the Right Hand
Reward: Skill gem choice (class-dependent).
Requirement: Kill General Gravicius; speak to Maramoa. Skippable despite its main-quest presentation in game.

Name: The Gemling Queen
Reward: Story progression: meet Lady Dialla; no separate reward choice listed.
Requirement: Find Lady Dialla in the Solaris Temple.

Name: Victario's Secrets
Reward: 1 passive skill point.
Requirement: Return all three platinum busts from the Sewers to Hargan.

Name: The Ribbon Spool
Reward: Choose an Amber, Jade, Lapis or Gold Amulet; prerequisite for Fiery Dust.
Requirement: Return the Ribbon Spool to Lady Dialla.

Name: Fiery Dust
Reward: Infernal Talc; passage through the Undying Blockage.
Requirement: Bring Thaumetic Sulphite to Lady Dialla; use the talc at the blockage.

Name: A Swig of Hope
Reward: Choose a Coral, Paua or Gold Ring.
Requirement: Requires the Marooned Mariner; bring the Decanter Spiritus and Chitus' Plum to Fairgraves.

Name: Piety's Pets
Reward: 1 passive skill point; Tower Key for the Sceptre of God.
Requirement: Defeat Piety; retrieve the key; speak to Grigor.

Name: A Fixture of Fate
Reward: Support gem choice (class-dependent); Siosa's cross-class gem shop unlock.
Requirement: Return four Golden Pages to Siosa in the Library. Shop purchases cost currency.

Name: The Sceptre of God
Reward: Access to Act 4; no separate reward choice.
Requirement: Use the Tower Key; defeat Dominus.

Name: Strange Growths
Reward: Anointing unlock / Blight introduction.
Requirement: Complete Cassia's Blight encounter and speak to her; availability depends on encounter spawns.

Name: Breaking the Seal
Reward: Skill gem choice (class-dependent); Mines access.
Requirement: Defeat Voll; bring Deshret's Banner to Oyun.

Name: An Indomitable Spirit
Reward: 1 passive skill point and 2 passive refund points.
Requirement: Free Deshret's spirit in the Mines; speak to Tasuni.

Name: The King of Fury
Reward: Eye of Fury for the Rapture Device; story progression.
Requirement: Defeat Kaom; take the eye to Lady Dialla.

Name: The King of Desire
Reward: Eye of Desire for the Rapture Device; story progression.
Requirement: Defeat Daresso; take the eye to Lady Dialla.

Name: Corpus Malachus
Reward: Access to Malachai; no separate reward choice listed.
Requirement: Collect Malachai's three organs from Shavronne, Maligaro and Doedre; speak to Piety.

Name: The Eternal Nightmare
Reward: Support gem choice (class-dependent, during the quest); story progression to Act 5.
Requirement: Complete the eye/organ quests and defeat Malachai; claim the offered town rewards.

Name: Niko's Fuel
Reward: Delve / Mine Encampment introduction.
Requirement: After Breaking the Seal, find Voltaxic Sulphite and speak to Niko.

Name: Niko's Mine
Reward: Delve and Azurite upgrade tutorial; no fixed item reward listed.
Requirement: Collect Azurite in the mine; speak to Niko.

Name: Niko's Explosives
Reward: Fractured-wall / explosives tutorial; no fixed item reward listed.
Requirement: Destroy a fractured wall in the mine; speak to Niko.

Name: Return to Oriath
Reward: Resistance ring choice (Ruby / Sapphire / Topaz / Two-Stone).
Requirement: Travel through the Ascent; defeat Overseer Krow; speak to Lani.

Name: The Key to Freedom
Reward: Utility flask choice (e.g. Granite / Jade / Diamond).
Requirement: Kill Justicar Casticus; take the Eyes of Zeal; speak to Lani.

Name: In Service to Science
Reward: 1 passive skill point.
Requirement: Return the Miasmeter to Vilenta.

Name: Death to Purity
Reward: Choose a Cobalt, Crimson or Viridian Jewel; story progression.
Requirement: Defeat High Templar Avarius / Innocence; speak to Lani.

Name: The King's Feast
Reward: Rare weapon / off-hand choice (class-dependent).
Requirement: Kill Utula in the Ruined Square; speak to Bannon.

Name: Kitava's Torments
Reward: 1 passive skill point and 2 passive refund points.
Requirement: Return all three Kitava relics to Lani.

Name: The Ravenous God
Reward: Access to Act 6. Consequence: -30% to elemental and chaos resistances.
Requirement: Confront Kitava at the Cathedral Rooftop; sail with Lilly.

Name: Fallen from Grace
Reward: 2 passive refund points; Lilly's non-drop-exclusive gem shop unlock.
Requirement: Clear the Twilight Strand; speak to Lilly. Gems are purchased, not all granted free.

Name: Bestel's Epic
Reward: Amulet or belt choice (e.g. Agate Amulet / Leather Belt).
Requirement: Return Bestel's Manuscript to Bestel.

Name: The Father of War
Reward: 1 passive skill point; Soul of Tukohama; passage onward.
Requirement: Defeat Tukohama; speak to Tarkleigh.

Name: Essence of Umbra
Reward: Helmet choice (class-dependent); passage onward.
Requirement: Defeat Shavronne; speak to Tarkleigh.

Name: The Cloven One
Reward: 1 passive skill point; Soul of Abberath.
Requirement: Defeat Abberath at Prisoner's Gate; speak to Bestel. Optional classification verified against PoEDB.

Name: The Puppet Mistress
Reward: 1 passive skill point; Soul of Ryslatha.
Requirement: Defeat Ryslatha in the Wetlands; speak to Tarkleigh.

Name: The Brine King
Reward: Soul of the Brine King; access to Act 7.
Requirement: Defeat Tsoagoth and sail onward.

Name: The Rogue Harbour
Reward: Heist / Rogue Harbour introduction.
Requirement: Travel to the Rogue Harbour; finish Contract: Trial Run; speak to Kurai.

Name: Unearthing the Past
Reward: Expedition / Gwennen trading introduction; no fixed completion item listed.
Requirement: Talk to Gwennen, place explosives, detonate and defeat the unearthed monsters; speak to her. Facts verified against PoEDB; wiki page incomplete.

Name: The Lost Expedition
Reward: Expedition story / mechanic introduction; no fixed completion item verified.
Requirement: Work with Dannig on ancient Kalguuran texts; the storyline continues into Expedition logbooks.

Name: The Silver Locket
Reward: Utility flask choice (e.g. Quartz / Granite / Jade).
Requirement: Return the Silver Locket to Weylam Roth.

Name: Essence of the Artist
Reward: Boots choice (class-dependent).
Requirement: Use Maligaro's Map; defeat Maligaro; speak to Helena.

Name: Web of Secrets
Reward: Obsidian Key; 1 passive skill point (Book of Skill).
Requirement: Return Black Venom to Silk to open the route through the Chamber of Sins.

Name: The Master of a Million Faces
Reward: 1 passive skill point; Soul of Ralakesh.
Requirement: Defeat Ralakesh; speak to Eramir.

Name: In Memory of Greust
Reward: Amulet choice (e.g. Onyx / Gold / Agate).
Requirement: Place Greust's Necklace at the shrine in the Northern Forest; speak to Helena.

Name: Queen of Despair
Reward: 1 passive skill point; Soul of Gruthkul.
Requirement: Defeat Gruthkul in the Dread Thicket; speak to Eramir.

Name: Kishara's Star
Reward: 1 passive skill point and 2 passive refund points.
Requirement: Return Kishara's Star to Weylam Roth.

Name: Lighting the Way
Reward: Temple access; no separate reward choice listed.
Requirement: Collect seven Fireflies; give them to Yeena.

Name: The Mother of Spiders
Reward: Soul of Arakaali; access to Act 8.
Requirement: Defeat Arakaali in the Temple of Decay.

Name: No Time like the Present
Reward: Incursion / Temple of Atzoatl introduction.
Requirement: Complete a temporal Incursion with Alva; availability depends on encounter spawns.

Name: Essence of the Hag
Reward: Two-Stone or Unset Ring choice; passage onward.
Requirement: Defeat Doedre; speak to Hargan.

Name: Love is Dead
Reward: 1 passive skill point and 2 passive refund points.
Requirement: Bring the Ankh of Eternity to Clarissa; defeat Tolman; speak to Clarissa.

Name: The Gemling Legion
Reward: 1 passive skill point.
Requirement: Kill the Gemling Legionnaires at the Grain Gate; speak to Maramoa.

Name: Reflection of Terror
Reward: 1 passive skill point; Soul of Yugul.
Requirement: Defeat Yugul; speak to Sin.

Name: The Wings of Vastiri
Reward: Choose a Cobalt, Crimson or Viridian Jewel.
Requirement: Return the Wings of Vastiri to Hargan.

Name: Lunar Eclipse
Reward: Moon Orb for the paired encounter; Soul of Lunaris; access to Act 9 after both gods.
Requirement: Obtain the Moon Orb from Dusk; use both orbs at the Harbour Bridge and defeat Solaris and Lunaris.

Name: Solar Eclipse
Reward: Sun Orb for the paired encounter; Soul of Solaris; shared Act 9 access, not an extra act unlock.
Requirement: Obtain the Sun Orb from Dawn; use both orbs at the Harbour Bridge and defeat Solaris and Lunaris.

Name: The Storm Blade
Reward: Weapon / off-hand choice (class-dependent).
Requirement: Return the Storm Blade to Petarus and Vanja.

Name: Fastis Fortuna
Reward: 2 passive refund points.
Requirement: Return the Calendar of Fortune to Petarus and Vanja.

Name: The Ruler of Highgate
Reward: 1 passive skill point; Soul of Garukhan. Choose the ruler by giving the feather to Tasuni OR Irasha.
Requirement: Defeat Garukhan; deliver the Sekhema Feather to your chosen recipient.

Name: Queen of the Sands
Reward: 1 passive skill point; Soul of Shakari.
Requirement: Gain access to the Oasis; defeat Shakari; speak to Irasha.

Name: Recurring Nightmare
Reward: Access to Act 10; no separate reward choice listed.
Requirement: Collect Basilisk Acid and Trarthan Powder; defeat the Depraved Trinity; speak to Lilly.

Name: The Immortal Syndicate
Reward: Betrayal / Syndicate introduction.
Requirement: Defeat a Syndicate encounter with Jun.

Name: Safe Passage
Reward: Flask choice (e.g. Divine Life / Divine Mana / utility flask).
Requirement: Rescue Bannon at the Cathedral Rooftop; speak to Lani.

Name: Map to Tsoatha
Reward: Belt choice (e.g. Heavy / Leather / Rustic Sash).
Requirement: Return the Teardrop to Lilly Roth.

Name: No Love for Old Ghosts
Reward: 2 passive refund points.
Requirement: Return the Elixir of Allure to Weylam Roth.

Name: Vilenta's Vengeance
Reward: 1 passive skill point.
Requirement: Kill Vilenta; speak to Lani.

Name: Death and Rebirth
Reward: Body-armour choice (class-dependent); story progression.
Requirement: Retrieve the Staff of Purity; give it to Bannon; speak to Lani.

Name: An End to Hunger
Reward: 2 passive skill points; campaign completion. Consequence: a further -30% to elemental and chaos resistances.
Requirement: Defeat Kitava; claim Lani's Book of Skill.

Name: Toward the Future
Reward: Travel to the Epilogue; no separate reward choice listed.
Requirement: After Kitava, speak to Lilly and set sail.

Name: Aiding an Archivist
Reward: Forbidden Sanctum / Relic Altar introduction.
Requirement: Return the Mortinomicon to Divinia; travel to the Forbidden Sanctum.

Name: Reaching Clearfell
Reward: Level 1 Uncut Skill Gem; Clearfell access.
Requirement: Defeat the Bloated Miller; speak to Renly.

Name: Treacherous Ground
Reward: Level 1 Uncut Support Gem and 100 gold.
Requirement: Defeat the Devourer in Mud Burrow; speak to Renly.

Name: Secrets in the Dark
Reward: Story progression: release the Hooded One.
Requirement: Find the runes in the Red Vale; return to Una at the Tree of Souls.

Name: The Mysterious Shade
Reward: Story progression: revive the Hooded One.
Requirement: Recover Count Lachlann's Ring; bring it to Una. The quest may also resolve at Geonor; follow your journal.

Name: Sorrow Among Stones
Reward: Level 3 Uncut Skill Gem; passage through the Memorial Gate.
Requirement: Collect Draven's and Asinia's key pieces; defeat Lachlann.

Name: The Trail of Corruption
Reward: Level 5 Uncut Skill Gem from Leitis.
Requirement: Follow the corruption toward Ogham and speak to Leitis.

Name: The Mad Wolf of Ogham
Reward: Level 1 Uncut Support Gem; access to Act 2.
Requirement: Defeat Count Geonor; claim the town reward.

Name: The Hunt Begins
Reward: Azmeri Spirit hunting introduction; no fixed completion item listed.
Requirement: Speak to Delwyn, follow the spirit and defeat the hunted monster in one instance.

Name: Ominous Altars
Reward: Choose a Ruby, Sapphire or Topaz Charm. Associated boss drop: +30 Spirit (Gembloom Skull), not a second quest choice.
Requirement: Cleanse Freythorn's ritual altars; defeat the King in the Mists; speak to Finn.

Name: The Lost Lute
Reward: 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points (Book of Specialisation).
Requirement: Return Una's Lute from the Ogham Farmlands to Una.

Name: Finding the Forge
Reward: Salvage Bench unlock.
Requirement: Return Renly's tools from Ogham Village.

Name: Earning Passage
Reward: Level 5 Uncut Skill Gem and 200 gold.
Requirement: Earn passage with the Ardura caravan; defeat Rathbreaker.

Name: The Trail of Corruption
Reward: Level 7 Uncut Skill Gem after Halani Gates; Level 2 Uncut Support Gem for recreating the Horn of the Vastiri.
Requirement: Complete the three horn-component quests below; continue the main route to Jamanra.

Name: A Theft of Ivory
Reward: Level 2 Uncut Support Gem and 400 gold.
Requirement: Find the Mastodon Tusks for the Horn of the Vastiri.

Name: The City of Seven Waters
Reward: Level 2 Uncut Support Gem and 400 gold.
Requirement: Find the Water Goddess's Essence for the Horn of the Vastiri.

Name: A Crown of Stone
Reward: Level 2 Uncut Support Gem and 400 gold.
Requirement: Find the Flame Ruby for the Horn of the Vastiri.

Name: Ascent to Power
Reward: Ascendancy class / first 2 Ascendancy points after the trial; magic Urn Relic and Relic Locker during introduction.
Requirement: Use a Barya; complete the Trial of the Sekhemas and claim the Altar of Ascendancy. Not awarded merely for entering.

Name: The Well of Souls
Reward: Well of Souls use unlock.
Requirement: Complete the Well of Souls introduction; see source for the current mechanic.

Name: Ancient Vows
Reward: Choose ONE: +1 Charm slot with 30% increased Charm charges gained, OR +1 Charm slot with 30% increased Charm effect duration. Choice can be changed at the altar.
Requirement: Place both Kabala Clan and Sun Clan relics at the Valley of the Titans altar.

Name: Tradition's Toll
Reward: 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points (Book of Specialisation).
Requirement: Return the Final Letter from Deshar to Shambrin.

Name: Legacy of the Vaal
Reward: Story progression through Act 3 to Act 4. Separate quest item rewards are not verified in the source.
Requirement: Follow the main Act 3 quest journal through the Vaal ruins and Doryani; no completion is inferred from area or level.

Name: The Slithering Dead
Reward: Artificer's Orb; choose ONE permanent bonus: 25% increased Stun Threshold, 30% increased Elemental Ailment Threshold, OR 25% increased Mana Regeneration Rate. Cannot change the choice.
Requirement: Return Corpse-snake Venom from the Venom Crypts to Servi.

Name: The Trials of Chaos
Reward: 2 Ascendancy points after a qualifying trial completion.
Requirement: Bring an Inscribed Ultimatum to the Temple of Chaos; finish the challenges. Further points require appropriate trials, not repeating this quest.

Name: Tribal Vengeance
Reward: Choose a magic Thawing, Staunching, Antidote, Dousing or Grounding Charm. Associated Ignagduk drop grants Spirit separately.
Requirement: Defeat Ignagduk in the Azak Bog; speak to Servi.

Name: Treasures of Utzaal
Reward: Level 10 Uncut Skill Gem, 1000 gold, Artificer's Orb and Reforging Bench unlock.
Requirement: Recover the treasures in the Molten Vault; return to Oswald.

Name: The Search
Reward: Story progression: assemble the Precursor weapon. Separate item rewards not verified in the source.
Requirement: Hire Makoru's ship; find the weapon pieces. Island requirements rotate: all potentially required branches below remain locked; follow your journal.

Name: Shrike Island
Reward: Story / weapon-piece progression when required; no separate completion item listed.
Requirement: Potential rotating requirement for The Search; defeat the Scourge of the Skies. Locked does not mean every island is required for every character.

Name: Land of the Kin
Reward: Story / weapon-piece progression when required; no separate completion item listed.
Requirement: Potential rotating requirement for The Search; defeat Krutog in the Volcanic Warrens.

Name: Whakapanu Island
Reward: Story / weapon-piece progression when required; no separate completion item listed.
Requirement: Potential rotating requirement for The Search; defeat Diamora.

Name: Abandoned Prison
Reward: Story / weapon-piece progression when required; no separate completion item listed.
Requirement: Potential rotating requirement for The Search; defeat the Prisoner.

Name: Dark Mists
Reward: 7500 gold, Level 13 Uncut Skill Gem and Mist-shrouded Tome. Associated rescue grants 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points.
Requirement: Potential rotating requirement for The Search; defeat Captain Hartlin, obtain Verisium Spikes and free Freya; speak to Tujen.

Name: Utopia
Reward: Story quest resolution; no separate completion item listed.
Requirement: Speak to Missionary Lorandis; sail to Arastas; speak to Servitor Marius.

Name: Hostile Takeover
Reward: Shoreline Hideout unlock.
Requirement: Clear the hideout encounter and claim it.

Name: Tribal Medicine
Reward: Choose ONE permanent lesson: 30% increased Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield; OR 15% of Armour applies to Elemental Damage, Deflection Rating equal to 12% of Evasion Rating and 12% faster start of Energy Shield recharge. Cannot change the choice.
Requirement: Bring the Great White One's Shark Fin to Kaimana.

Name: The Runeseeker
Reward: Plunder's Point Expedition / Runeforging introduction. The special Expedition is one attempt.
Requirement: Find Torn Map Pieces and bring them to Dannig; start the Plunder's Point Expedition.

Name: Trial of the Ancestors
Reward: Eye of Hinekora unlock; Tattoo of Hinekora grants 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points.
Requirement: Complete the Ancestors quest and speak to Hinekora; additional tattoos below are separate tests.

Name: Tawhoa's Test
Reward: Choose ONE permanent tattoo: +5 Dexterity OR +5% Lightning Resistance. Cannot change the choice.
Requirement: Finish Tawhoa's test in the Halls of the Dead; exchange the blank tattoo at its totem.

Name: Tasalio's Test
Reward: Choose ONE permanent tattoo: +5 Intelligence OR +5% Cold Resistance. Cannot change the choice.
Requirement: Finish Tasalio's test in the Halls of the Dead; exchange the blank tattoo at its totem.

Name: Ngamahu's Test
Reward: Choose ONE permanent tattoo: +5 Strength OR +5% Fire Resistance. Cannot change the choice.
Requirement: Finish Ngamahu's test in the Halls of the Dead; exchange the blank tattoo at its totem.

Name: Recruit the Ezomytes
Reward: Story progression; no fixed quest reward item.
Requirement: Travel to Ogham; defeat Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth.

Name: Recruit the Maraketh
Reward: Story progression; no fixed quest reward item.
Requirement: Travel to the Bazaar; defeat Azmadi, the Faridun Prince.

Name: Recruit the Vaal
Reward: Story progression; no fixed quest reward item.
Requirement: Travel to Mount Kriar; defeat Zelina and Zolin.

Name: Siege of Oriath
Reward: 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points (Interlude Book of Specialisation); access to the Epilogue.
Requirement: Complete all three recruitment Interludes; claim the Hooded One's book in Kingsmarch and follow the Oriath quest.

Name: Clearing the Way
Reward: 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points (Book of Specialisation).
Requirement: Defeat Akthi and Anundr; speak to Risu.

Name: Howling Winds
Reward: 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points (Book of Specialisation).
Requirement: Defeat the Abominable Yeti; speak to Hilda.
